test_queries.name: Simple SELECT
test_queries.query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = 'john@example.com'
test_queries.description: Простой запрос с фильтрацией по email

test_queries.name: JOIN with aggregation
test_queries.query: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) as order_count, SUM(o.total_amount) as total_spent FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.is_active = true GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC

test_queries.name: Complex subquery
test_queries.query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE total_amount > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders))

test_queries.name: Window function
test_queries.query: SELECT name, total_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC) as rank FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id

test_queries.name: Inefficient query (no index)
test_queries.query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%John%'

test_queries.name: Multiple JOINs
test_queries.query: SELECT u.name, o.total_amount, oi.product_name, oi.quantity FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'

test_queries.name: Aggregation with HAVING
test_queries.query: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as order_count, AVG(total_amount) as avg_amount FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

test_queries.name: Date range query
test_queries.query: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

test_queries.name: Inefficient implicit JOIN
test_queries.query: SELECT u.name, o.total_amount FROM users u, orders o WHERE u.id = o.user_id AND o.status = 'completed'

test_queries.name: Subquery that can be JOIN
test_queries.query: SELECT u.name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = u.id) as order_count FROM users u WHERE u.is_active = true
test_queries.description: Подзапрос, который можно заменить на JOIN

test_queries.name: No LIMIT on large result
test_queries.query: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC
test_queries.description: Запрос без LIMIT, который может вернуть много строк

test_queries.name: Inefficient WHERE with function
test_queries.query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE UPPER(name) = 'JOHN DOE'

test_queries.name: Multiple subqueries
test_queries.query: SELECT name FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE total_amount > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'))

test_queries.name: Inefficient LIKE pattern
test_queries.query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%John%' OR email LIKE '%john%'
test_queries.description: Неэффективные паттерны LIKE с ведущими символами

test_queries.name: Cross join instead of proper JOIN
test_queries.query: SELECT u.name, o.total_amount FROM users u CROSS JOIN orders o WHERE u.id = o.user_id

test_queries.name: Simple UPDATE
test_queries.query: UPDATE users SET last_login = NOW() WHERE email = 'john@example.com'

test_queries.name: UPDATE with JOIN
test_queries.query: UPDATE orders SET status = 'completed' FROM users u WHERE orders.user_id = u.id AND u.email = 'john@example.com'

test_queries.name: UPDATE with subquery
test_queries.query: UPDATE users SET is_active = false WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 1000)

test_queries.name: Bulk UPDATE
test_queries.query: UPDATE orders SET status = 'archived' WHERE created_at < '2023-01-01'

test_queries.name: UPDATE with calculation
test_queries.query: UPDATE order_items SET total_price = quantity * unit_price WHERE total_price IS NULL

test_queries.name: Simple DELETE
test_queries.query: DELETE FROM users WHERE email = 'old@example.com'

test_queries.name: DELETE with JOIN
test_queries.query: DELETE FROM orders USING users u WHERE orders.user_id = u.id AND u.email = 'john@example.com'

test_queries.name: DELETE with subquery
test_queries.query: DELETE FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE total_amount < 10)

test_queries.name: Bulk DELETE
test_queries.query: DELETE FROM orders WHERE created_at < '2022-01-01'

test_queries.name: DELETE with LIMIT
test_queries.query: DELETE FROM users WHERE is_active = false LIMIT 100

test_queries.name: Inefficient UPDATE (no index)
test_queries.query: UPDATE users SET last_login = NOW() WHERE name LIKE '%John%'

test_queries.name: Inefficient DELETE (no index)
test_queries.query: DELETE FROM orders WHERE status LIKE '%old%'
